scenario_description:
Objective: Reach the Rochester government center for an afternoon interpreting assignment using the prebooked Jefferson Lines trip from Saint Paul Union Depot.
Emerging Need: The planned boarding process starts normally, then the active boarding attempt fails when the mobile QR cannot validate and self-service reprint is unavailable.
Decision Context: The only workable recovery depends on finding Jonas’s existing confirmation details quickly enough for manual counter release before boarding closes.
Consequence: If the stalled boarding is not helped promptly, the bus leaves and the same trip can no longer get him there for the assignment.

parameter.title: Leave for Rochester interpreting trip
parameter.content: Leave with interpreting kit for the Jefferson Lines trip to Rochester and the 2:00 PM government center assignment.

parameter.subject: Mobile boarding pass ready for today's Rochester trip
parameter.body: Your mobile boarding pass is ready in the Jefferson Lines app for the 11:20 AM departure from Saint Paul Union Depot to Rochester. If the app cannot display a scannable code, a station counter reprint can be used before gate close.

parameter.description: Green Line fare toward Saint Paul Union Depot for Rochester bus connection

parameter.content: Jefferson Lines self-service ticket kiosks at Gate B are offline this morning. Passengers needing a paper ticket must use the staffed counter before boarding closes.

parameter.subject: Boarding scan failed at Gate B
parameter.body: The Gate B scanner could not validate the mobile QR for the boarding attempt just recorded for the 11:20 AM Saint Paul to Rochester trip. Because kiosks are offline, boarding cannot continue from the app; counter staff can manually release the ticket only before gate close.

parameter.subject: Saint Paul to Rochester 11:20 AM departure closed
parameter.body: Boarding for the 11:20 AM Saint Paul Union Depot to Rochester departure is closed and the coach has departed. The next available Rochester departure is 3:40 PM.
